name: @bevox/core
description: bevox-hetzner-mcp core — agent-native Hetzner control plane (state store, reconciler, providers, MCP interface)
ciNote: CI runs `npm --prefix core test` + integration fakes on every commit; `@live` manual pre-release only.
securityNotes: npm audit: 5 moderate are dev-only (vitest@2→esbuild, GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99); accepted — no runtime/CI exposure, vitest pinned ^2 per ratified plan & parity with console/. Revisit if vitest majors.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/store/migrations && cp src/store/migrations/*.sql dist/store/migrations/

engineNote: node >=20.12.0 (bumped from >=20.0.0) so the native `node --env-file-if-exists` flag — used by start/dev and the documented built run path to load core/.env with zero new dependency — is guaranteed available (it lands in Node 20.12). The flag tolerates an absent file (process-manager/container-injected env), then loadConfig still fails fast value-free.
